target_audience: German-speaking children aged 3-7 learning Spanish with parents
design_principles: Audio-First & Tactile Interaction: Designed for toddlers and young children with oversized touch targets (minimum 64px tall/wide), rounded corners (rounded-3xl/2xl), and instant auditory + visual feedback.
Bilingual Clarity: Every Spanish word is paired directly with its German translation in high-contrast text and clear icons.
3D Toy World Aesthetic: Rich depth, soft dropshadows, warm cream canvas, turquoise glass/solid containers, sunny yellow badges, and coral primary actions.
Safety & Parent Control: Kid interface is distraction-free with zero ads or tracking; full settings, vocabulary analytics, and printables locked behind a parent PIN gate.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app (App.js) with clear tab/section switching between: Home/Games, Songs, Printable Sheets, Parent View, and Admin View.

Strictly follow the color palette: Turquoise #169CA3 for key UI accents/headers, Coral #F36F5B for CTAs, Sunny Yellow #F6BC35 for stars/badges, Warm Cream #FFF8EA for background, Deep Teal #174B50 for readable body text.

Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, game cards, PIN inputs, admin inputs) include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='play-now-btn', data-testid='game-card-apple', data-testid='parent-pin-submit').
Add audio playback support using Web Audio API synthetic speech synth or HTML5 Audio so kids get audible feedback when pressing cards/buttons.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for Parent & Admin actions (e.g. 'Bild freigegeben', 'Vokabel gespeichert', 'PIN korrekt').
Keep text minimal, clear, friendly, and bilingual for vocabulary elements.
